expected.title: Effectiveness of antipsychotic drugs in patients with chronic schizophrenia.
expected.result: Seventy-four percent discontinued assigned treatment before 18 months; olanzapine had longer persistence than some agents but greater weight and metabolic effects, while perphenazine had similar effectiveness to several newer agents and more extrapyramidal effects.
expected.limitation: Very high discontinuation limits long-term outcome ascertainment; time to discontinuation combines efficacy, tolerability, and other reasons rather than isolating symptom efficacy.
